parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test targets: `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift` and `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift`. The types involved (`MockArtworkService+Artwork` and `MockArtworkService`) are mock fixtures used within their respective test suites. Per the decision rules, any cluster where a participating record is a test fixture warrants no-action; here both records are test fixtures, making consolidation inappropriate — merging them would couple two independent test packages through shared mock infrastructure, risking false test dependencies.
